title: Excursion to Rio Tinto and Aracena
text: The excursion is very good and you see many curious things. It is a full-day excursion but it is done by car so it is very comfortable to do. Our guide was Miguel and he was very nice and adapted to us at all times. It is better to book the excursion directly with them because they give you a discount for the next ones.
author: Discover20966338920

title: Great excursion
text:
We recommend doing this really rewarding excursion! 
Our guide Sergio was exceptional, rich in knowledge and thanks to him we were able to see really great places we would not have been without knowing. 
The cave of wonders is also superb! 
 Not to be missed:)
author: 305emelynel

title: Amazing natural wonder and authentic restaurant experiences.
text: As a result from our good experience w/ the bike tour, we booked our private tour to Gruta de las Maravillas.  It’s nice to change the scene from Seville to the small towns w/ a comfortable transportation.  The underground cave is really a natural wonder.  The limestone formations are so stunning, the “lake” water was so pure and clear.  Our guide Nacho brought us to an authentic restaurant and helped us order food that he would normally eat.  We feel that we are truly immersed to some local experiences.
author: Eric C

title: Unforgettable experience and Driss is a legend
text:
The tour was amazing. I have been on other tours before with this company and always had great experiences. Very professional, timely, polite and great trips and great value for money. 

This particular trip to the Rio Tinto river and mines was really funky to see a new part of the region, great for photographers with the mars like landscapes and the unbelievable beauty of the underground caves really do feel magical. 

However the tour was made so amazing by our fabulous tour guide - Driss. A bundle of joy and energy he was amazing at leading the group, entertaining and bringing us all togeth
author: jamesaX1608WK

title: Riotinto & Aracena
text: Fun and interesting trip to the Rio Tinto mines and the caves in Aracena. Our guide Nacho was very friendly and entertaining, and knew about the history of Spain. Nice lunch in Aracena, and the red river and the caves were beautiful.
author: erjakatriina

title: Excursion to the Rio Tinto and Aracena mines.
text: We were able to observe the Rio Tinto mines from different places. It was very impressive. We also visited the Castle of Aracena and the Grotto of Wonders. We had a great day. Our guide Sergio, was very friendly throughout. And he gave us a lot of interesting information. The day was short. We had a great time.
author: María B

title: A day in Aracena and rio tinto.
text: Great company to deal with.  Chauffeur was fantastic and very knowledgeable!!!!!   Great tour.  Learned a lot.   Very beautiful country
author: key310

title: The caves at Aracena
text: Carlos (guide) and Lola (driver) make an excellent team. Carlos was very knowledgeable. The tour was well organised with plenty of stops for photo opportunities. The caves at Aracena are well worth a visit.
author: Mike L

title: RIO TINTO, incredible scenery.
text:
The tour of the Rio Tinto mines was an exciting discovery orchestrated by our Pro Geology and History Guide. Stunning landscapes, unique, magnificent and beautiful. 
The choice of the village of Almonaster de la Real in the program of this visit is great. A gem away from the crowd in the authenticity of local life. As for the Gruta de las Maravillosas, a true fairy tale, even for regulars to visit the caves of Périgord. 
This journey has enchanted us beyond what we had imagined. A big thank you to Sergio!
author: Paradise52137901484

title: Unmissable trip
text:
Great trip 
Comfy transport 
Informative guides
Mines very interesting 
The caves were incredible easily the highlight of our week.
